findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/TensorProduct.lean:48` `TensorProduct.instBialgebra : Bialgebra S (A ⊗[R] B)` under `[Bialgebra S A] [Bialgebra R B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R S] [IsScalarTower R S A]`; `Mathlib/RingTheory/Coalgebra/Basic.lean:215` `CommSemiring.comul_apply` needs only `[CommSemiring R]`; `Mathlib/FieldTheory/AbsoluteGaloisGroup.lean:43` `absoluteGaloisGroup K := AlgebraicClosure K ≃ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure K`. The repo's own group-like API is unbundled (`TauCeti/Algebra/HopfAlgebra/GroupLike/FiniteGeneration.lean:69-71`: `(R : Type u) (H : Type v) [CommRing R] [Ring H] [HopfAlgebra R H]`), and the bundling already costs a `change` through "two bundled base-change layers" at `TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/MultiplicativeType/CharacterLattice.lean:49-52`.
findings.fix: State the action unbundled and for a general scalar factor: `variable {k L A : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing L] [Algebra k L] [CommRing A] [HopfAlgebra k A]`, `def galoisScalarMap (σ : L ≃ₐ[k] L) : L ⊗[k] A →ₐ[k] L ⊗[k] A`, with `MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[k] L) (L ⊗[k] A)` and the group-like preservation lemma; then define `geometricCharacterGroup k A := GroupLike (AlgebraicClosure k) (AlgebraicClosure k ⊗[k] A)` and obtain the absolute-Galois instance by transporting along `Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k = (AlgebraicClosure k ≃ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k)`. `instCharacterLatticeGaloisAction` then also becomes general instead of one-off.
findings.issue: `galoisScalarMap` and everything built on it (lines 56–182: semilinearity, counit/comul equivariance, `isGroupLikeElem_galoisScalarMap`, `instGaloisScalarMulSemiringAction`) is stated for a bundled `H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k` over a *field* with the scalar factor fixed to `AlgebraicClosure k` and the acting group fixed to `Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k`. None of that strength is used: the definition is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ.toAlgHom (AlgHom.id k H)`, the bialgebra instance on the tensor factor is `TensorProduct.instBialgebra` (needs only `[Bialgebra k A]`, `[Algebra k L]`), and the comul proof only uses `CommSemiring.comul_apply` for `L`. `[Field k]` and the same-universe restriction `H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k` are likewise unused.

findings.evidence: `torusCommHopfAlgProperty_iff` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Torus/Basic.lean:105-113) yields exactly an iso `coordinateRing (AlgebraicClosure k) (SplitTorus.characterGroup (ULift (Fin n))) ≅ baseChange H`; `DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangeCoordinateRingIso` (DiagonalizableGroup/BaseChange.lean:85-91) is `scalarTensorBialgEquiv` bundled, i.e. the input the diagonalizable proof uses inline; `coordinateRing R G = FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.of R (MonoidAlgebra R G)` (DiagonalizableGroup/FiniteType.lean:81-83).
findings.fix: Prove once `geometricCharacterGroupEquivOfIso (k) [Field k] (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u,u} k) (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (i : DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing (AlgebraicClosure k) G ≅ FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChange (K := AlgebraicClosure k) H) : geometricCharacterGroup H.obj ≃* G`, plus one additive-form corollary; derive `DiagonalizableGroup.geometricCharacterGroupEquiv` from `(baseChangeCoordinateRingIso k (AlgebraicClosure k) G).symm` and `exists_characterLattice_addEquiv_of_torus` from the iso supplied by `torusCommHopfAlgProperty_iff`.
findings.issue: The same argument — from an iso `coordinateRing k̄ G ≅ baseChange H` conclude `geometricCharacterGroup H ≃* G` via `GroupLike.mapEquiv` followed by `MonoidAlgebra.groupLikeEquiv` — is written out separately here (lines 51–63) and in `DiagonalizableGroup/CharacterLattice.lean:40-45`, with the `MulEquiv.toAdditive … |>.trans (AddEquiv.additiveMultiplicative …)` wrapper duplicated again in `SplitTorus/CharacterLattice.lean:39-41`. The special cases are proved, but the general result is never stated.

findings.evidence: `multiplicativeTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff_exists_iso_coordinateRing` (MultiplicativeType/Basic.lean:85-90) already supplies `∃ G : FGCommGrpCat, Nonempty (coordinateRing (AlgebraicClosure k) G ≅ baseChange H)`; `instance (G : FGCommGrpCat) : Group.FG G` at TauCeti/Algebra/Category/CommGrpCat/FiniteGeneration.lean:73-74.
findings.fix: State `∃ G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}, Nonempty (geometricCharacterGroup H.obj ≃* G)` using the general lemma of the previous finding applied to `multiplicativeTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff_exists_iso_coordinateRing`, and derive `Group.FG` as a corollary (objects of `FGCommGrpCat` carry `Group.FG`).
findings.issue: `geometricCharacterGroup_fg_of_multiplicativeType` records only `Group.FG`, which is strictly weaker than what the same hypothesis gives: the character group is *equivalent to* the finitely generated group presenting the base change.

summary: The Galois-action development is stated for a bundled `CommHopfAlgCat` object and hardwired to `AlgebraicClosure k`/`absoluteGaloisGroup k`, although no proof uses either; and the same "base change is a monoid algebra ⇒ character group is its index group" argument is re-derived three times instead of proved once and specialized.
